scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production npx @tailwindcss/cli -i styles/styles.css -o static/styles.css -m && NODE_ENV=production npx @tailwindcss/cli -i styles/project-pages.css -o static/project-pages.css -m
scripts.watch: trap 'kill $(jobs -p) 2>/dev/null' EXIT; npx @tailwindcss/cli -i styles/styles.css -o static/styles.css --watch & npx @tailwindcss/cli -i styles/project-pages.css -o static/project-pages.css --watch & wait
